publicPairs starts with (a_j,1); canonical quotientSlope is positive below odd prime m and satisfies a_j*j²=N modm.
The initial Euclidean quotient m/a_j equals one exactly at a_j>m/2; named subgroups are genuine current-ray subfamilies.
Both liftRow divisions are exact under the public inverse and slope congruences; b_j*j=-D_j modm follows from the literal centered inverse.
j to m-j preserves the slope and stream; D shift and b-wrap give ell_j+ell_jprime=m²h exactly.
Positive first-current publicShift has (A,B)=(U+V,V+W); reflectedShift swaps them, using the actual integer square roots.
Centered e=-floor(C/m²)+epsilon with epsilon in {-1,0}; pure epsilon in {0,1}. Both follow from paired floors and integer h.
The common d_j uses only gamma and alpha integer powers; no residual or square root is divided out.
Parity splitting yields -1/2<=c<1 in both conventions, hence -m²<r<3m²/2 without deleting carries.
j ell=-N-a j² modm²; squaring and cancelling unit j² gives r²=4aN modm².
r=-2N/j modm is a nonzero bijection on tags because 2N is a unit; every nonempty subset has at most one support point per lowdigit.
Differences in the proved band have absolute value <5m²/2; local order>3m² and distinct lowdigits give injection only for the normalized first-current targets.
ell²-4atN=m²(b²-4ac) holds for every original lifted ray, including signed a; no full-catalog lowdigit injection is inferred.
For fixed canonical a and nonzero lowdigit u, v=-(u²-4aN)/m*(2u)^(-1) modm is the unique lift. All operations use public m.
Canonical modulo-m² residues are a mask abstraction; genuine gamma carries remain explicit nonzero unit weights.
Phi_m²(X+1) is monic, reduces to X^(m²-m) modulo m, and has constant m, so Eisenstein proves irreducibility over Q.
Phi division with degree< m² forces all highdigit coefficients in each lowdigit stack equal; a nonempty singleton stack contradicts it.
The characteristic-zero proof permits arbitrary nonzero rational weights; it does not by itself assert finite-characteristic nonvanishing.
The retained first-K menu and folded gap selector yield O(M²(G+1)) Q choices at fixed P,m; summed gap mass is O(K_*M).
Exactly m-1 unit classes solve x^(m-1)=1 modm², one per nonzero low residue by a nonzero linear Hensel derivative.
O(M²) exceptional P integers times O(M²(G+1)) Q choices, summed and symmetrized, gives O(K_*M⁵)=O(M^5.020).
The deletion is taken over all candidate m before adaptation on the same actual supply; no seed-axis multiplier is added and the earlier soft M^5.994 loss dominates.
Pinned authority gives exact prime R orders in both fields uniformly over the registered choices; R≫m² and p,q≠m remain valid after deletion.
Failure of the Teich condition forces ord_m²(p)=m ord_m(p); Frobenius orbit lengths give extension degree m over Fp(zeta^m).
In the basis 1,zeta,...,zeta^(m-1), each occupied coefficient is a single nonzero monomial over the coarse field; nonzero at every primitive root follows.
Known gamma phase, carry and baby-origin units reduce to nonzero field coefficients. F_actual and F_S(gamma*zeta) retain the same singleton-stack argument.
A contract writing every nonzero primitive channel has m²-m records. The report does not lower-bound compressed orbit or scalar representations.
An unweighted full antipodal pair mask is reciprocal symmetric; pairing k,-k saves at most two. Arbitrary weighted even projection may vanish and is expressly excluded.
Phi_m² divides X^m²-1; the latter is separable in both hidden fields because p,q do not divide m.
No primitive root zeros imply polynomial Bezout inverses in both fields, CRT yields a unit in A_N, and multiplication determinant/resultant is therefore a unit with gcd1.
All occupied lowdigits are nonzero. Subtracting arbitrary G(zeta^m) changes only basis coordinate zero, so F-G(T^m) is again a unit with norm gcd1, including adaptive nonunit-coefficient G.
Multiplication by the unit mask preserves zero/nonzero status at each primitive frequency and changes any primitive determinant norm only by a unit.
Even a freely supplied primitive cyclotomic phase-mask norm cannot give a proper factor on the retained majority. This norm is expressly distinguished from the unpaid long residual norm.
Genuine lowdigit corrections, arbitrary row combinations, implicit scalar algorithms, different residuals, proper recovery and universal factoring lower bounds remain outside the theorem.
No new Lean, formal clock, coverage theorem or guaranteed sixth-rate factoring algorithm is asserted; all prior authorities remain unchanged.
